meta.title: Download Masar X — Windows, macOS, Android
meta.description: Download the Masar X desktop app for Windows. Works offline. Auto-updates. Syncs with your account.

windows.name: Windows
windows.installerHint: Requires installation — recommended for most users
windows.portableHint: No install needed — run from any folder

features.title: Why the desktop app?
features.offlineBody: Download once, access your materials anytime — even without a connection.
features.updatesBody: The app silently checks for new versions in the background and installs them.
features.systemBody: Tray notifications, taskbar, keyboard shortcuts — feels like a real app, not a tab.

free.a: Yes, 100%. Masar X is a free learning tool for students.

account.a: Not for downloading or installing. An account is only required for synced content (summaries, exams, courses).

update.q: How do I make sure I have the latest version?
update.a: The app checks for updates automatically. If a new version is available, a tray notification will appear.

uninstall.a: Go to Windows Settings > Apps > Masar X > Uninstall. For the portable edition, just delete the file.

error.title: Could not fetch the latest release
error.body: Try again in a moment, or download directly from the releases page: {url}
